bullets: The Spice Boys held on to top spot for a second week, scoring 91 to reach 322 points, but the lead is down to just 2 over Ctrl Alt Deligt.
Ctrl Alt Deligt, Ming Dynasty and Show Me The Mane shared the week's highest score with 98 points, lifting Ctrl Alt Deligt to 2nd and Ming Dynasty to 4th.
Show Me The Mane was the biggest riser, jumping 7 places to 13th on 268 after a Triple Captain week.
Macrinus had the week's lowest score with 47 points, against a league median of 83, and slid 5 places to 17th.
True Baleba FC was the biggest faller, down 7 places to 16th on 255 after scoring 49 on a Wildcard.
Palmer of Chelsea was the most captained pick, worn by 8 of 21 managers, and returned only 5 points.
The highest scoring player owned in this league was Groß of Brighton with 17 points, held by 11 of 21 managers.
Four teams played Wildcard (The Spice Boys, Bruno D'Or, Keith's Team and True Baleba FC), Show Me The Mane played Triple Captain, and 77 transfers were made across the league.
